headline: Grand Theft Auto 6 Generates Record $2.36 Billion in First-Day Global Sales
summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 achieved an estimated $2.36 billion in pre-orders and day-one retail sales, setting a record for the largest entertainment release in history.
why: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. is a major video game publisher that owns Rockstar Games, developer of the GTA series.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive
impacts.why: GTA 6 generated $2.36 billion in initial revenue, breaking previous entertainment industry sales records.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
